coachEvents.text: Jab, cross, jab, cross — straight time, fourteen bars. Four straight slots and back to guard.
Coast bar — jab, cross, empty, empty, time-and-a-half, twenty-six bars. Same pair, a little quicker. The reset stays visible.
Coast bar — jab, cross, empty, empty, double-time, twenty-eight bars. Speed lives inside the pair, not in the reset.
